meta.title: Diego Sanchez · Senior Frontend Engineer
meta.description: Frontend engineer building high-performance interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Based in Argentina, shipping globally.
meta.ogDescription: Senior Frontend Engineer. React, Next.js, TypeScript.

projects.description: Where engineering precision meets interfaces that refuse to feel ordinary.

propSource.description: Built a financial calculator with 100+ form fields — including dynamically computed values — deployed inside a Salesforce environment, helping agents evaluate property deals instantly. Expanded into a full buyer portal with interactive Google Maps listings, Auth0 authentication, and dynamic PDF report generation powered by Puppeteer and EJS. Both Next.js applications hosted on AWS using ECR and ECS.

fetcher.description: Sole developer on a fully responsive, pixel-perfect marketing website with every page connected to Strapi as a headless CMS — including blog and guides. Achieved excellent Lighthouse scores by choosing the right Next.js data fetching pattern (SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR) per page. Integrated Marketo, PostHog, Meta Pixel, and Qualified for marketing analytics. All schema markup and Open Graph tags served from Strapi and fully bot-scrapable. WCAG 2.1 compliant and SEO-optimized end to end.

neovim.description: A plug-and-play NeoVim configuration built for speed — because coding in a modal terminal editor is the fastest workflow on earth. Follows world-standard conventions with a focus on performance and readability. Open source and ready to use for anyone who wants a solid starting point. Built it for myself, sharing it because that's what open source is about.

experience.description: Real teams, real constraints — where the craft gets tested and the details matter most.

uberall.description: Location marketing platform for multi-location enterprise brands — part of the Websites team building the Locator & Local Pages products.
highlights: Building the next-generation Locator on Next.js 16 and React 19 — a multi-tenant, config-driven store locator and local pages product for enterprise brands
Shipping to the embeddable store-finder widget, where every merge goes live for all embedded clients, and contributing to its new server-side rendering service
Raising accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA with real screen-reader verification, alongside structured data and SEO work on location pages
Running an AI-augmented engineering workflow with Claude Code — custom agents, skills, and verification loops that take a ticket from spec to a reviewed merge request

inaza.description: Insurtech company automating insurance processes end-to-end — built AI-powered workflows replacing manual operations, and led AI coding tool adoption company-wide.
highlights: Appointed by the CEO to lead AI adoption company-wide — evaluated Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf, and standardized the engineering team on Claude Code
Authored the full Claude Code onboarding playbook — skills, agents, subagents, rules, hooks, and CLAUDE.md conventions — and ran a dedicated Slack channel guiding the IT team
Built email intake automation with OCR extraction, Vertex AI categorization, and automated responses through Graph API and Gmail — eliminating manual triage across departments
Engineered document processing pipelines with AI-powered routing of hundreds of insurance claims weekly, replacing manual data entry with Python and Pydantic validation

litebox.description: Boutique software studio building high-performance marketing websites and scalable back-office platforms for US startups — led frontend architecture, tooling, and development standards across all client projects.
highlights: Delivered 10+ marketing websites with 95+ Lighthouse scores, WCAG 2.2 compliance, schema markup SEO, and complex GSAP/Framer Motion animations — all pixel-perfect from design to Tailwind

Architected scalable back-office applications integrating React Hook Form with Zod validation, Google Maps API, OpenAI SDK, and AWS services — with Jest unit testing ensuring reliability across all projects
Established a headless CMS-first architecture connecting every marketing site to Strapi or Payload — and built an internal CLI automating full Next.js + Strapi project scaffolding
Early adopter of Spec-Driven Development with Claude and Cursor, documenting flows and processes in Notion and Excalidraw to align cross-functional teams

axon.description: LatAm's leading remote coaching school for athletes and professional leaders — maintained and modernized legacy systems while shipping new features on top of existing infrastructure.
highlights: Built an internal CRM application from scratch using React composition patterns, React Hook Form with Zod validation, and TypeScript — streamlining the entire sales department workflow
Developed a WhatsApp Bot with a custom webhook backend, structured entity models, and database management built on design patterns for sales reminders and payment notifications
Maintained and improved legacy codebases, resolving technical debt while delivering new features without disrupting existing functionality
Ensured cross-browser compatibility, security standards, and CI/CD automation across all projects

about.description: The perspective that shapes the work — where curiosity meets discipline and nothing ships without intention.
about.bio: I'm Diego — a Frontend Engineer with 5+ years crafting high-performance web applications. Based in Argentina, shipping globally. The details most people skip are the ones I obsess over — render performance, animation timing, design fidelity, and the kind of polish that makes an app feel alive.

footer.description: Obsessed with the details most people skip.

loading.tagline: Where bold ideas learn to breathe
